description_en: Retrieves the voice configurations for corpus broadcasting
description_zh: 获取语料播报的声音配置
name: GetSpeechVoice

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Items.description_en: The list of corpus broadcasting voices
Items.description_zh: 返回的语料播报声音列表

Label.description_en: The voice label that indicates the applicable scenario of the voice, such as general-purpose scenario, customer service scenario, or child voice scenario
Label.description_zh: 声音标签，标注声音的适用场景，例如通用场景、客服场景、童声场景等

Label.description_en: The broadcasting voice label that indicates the type of the voice, such as standard male voice or standard female voice
Label.description_zh: 播报声音标签，标注声音的类型，例如标准男声、标准女声等

Value.description_en: The broadcasting voice value. Pass this value to the Voice parameter in the following API operations: [CreateSpeech]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217571.html） and [TestSpeech]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217575.html）
Value.description_zh:
播报声音值，需要填入Voice参数的API，例如：
[CreateSpeech]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217571.html）、[TestSpeech]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217575.html），传入该字段的值

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
ErrorMessage.example: speech solution has not been signed

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。

false：调用失败
